authorization: 授权10轮实验额度，请你继续主导阶段三研究，达成可以推进至阶段四的状态
hypothesis: Repeated original recovery signals during an existing holding may carry information that is lost by exiting on a fixed earlier timer. Signal-driven renewal may capture later recovery without a fictional sell/rebuy.
prior_evidence: EX019 profit extension improved common-entry cycles but missed44 original entries; losses from occupied-position paths exceeded common-entry gains. This motivates testing exit/entry coordination, not selecting future missed winners.
original_entry: Keep ready & negative opening gap & positive intraday candle & original high environment; calibration/sample maturity/readiness unchanged.
renewal_signal: qualified = ready & parent & high; parent = ready & parent. Initial entry always qualified. Signals only, not hypothetical next-day buy fills.
clock: BUY fill E starts deadline=E+h-1 close. Each held close i, including entry-day close, if qualifying renewal and no pending exit: new_deadline=max(old_deadline,i+h), capped at E+max_hold-1 when max_hold>0. At deadline close emit SELL for next session. cap0 means no absolute duration cap.
pending_exit: Once SELL emitted, failed execution keeps exit latched and cannot be withdrawn by any later signal. No extra buy, sale, resizing, or fees during renewal.
sampling: Optuna manages eight enqueued fixed-grid trials; no adaptive sampler or pruning. Seed17. Public TDR batch evaluation max_workers2/native_threads1. Exactly eight unique configs, old H3/H6 evidence reused.
frozen: S014 existing pinned inputs, nominal2020-01-01..2026-10-15/1642sessions,100000cash,.001eachside,originalHFQ/limit-buy/market-sell rules/100sharelots/BuyHold/no annualreset/no terminalclose. No upstream calls or new source/phasefour.
targets: Everyyear return>=1.5*BH if BH>0 else >0; everyyear DD strictly below BH; 2026partial included;60*CLOSED/1642>=3.
decision: Retain valid negative outcomes, compare years and opportunity paths. At least one all-target passing candidate plus verified causal implementation, complete public evidence and registered frontier is required for phasefour readiness; full-period profit alone cannot close the goal.
limits: All sample previously seen; adaptive research history disclosed; signal continuation is not causal attribution of future missed trades. No retrospective yearly switches. cap0 may suppress frequency and increase tails.
